nusmp.page.book_cotton.fluffy_sheep_cush: Fluffy Sheep Cushion - a huge sheep of cotton appears and its wool catches everyone nearby. You and up to 8 allies within 6 blocks float down softly and are padded (slow fall, resistance and absorption); foes in the circle are bounced away without a scratch. Charmy's cushion.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunderclap_cr: Thunderclap Crumbling Orb - lightning gathered in the claws is thrown as a ball. It flies up to 22 blocks, bursts on the first thing it meets and shocks up to 8 foes within 3 blocks for 13 base damage and a short slow. Cheap enough to throw again and again.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_gods_g: Thunder God's Gloves - lightning gauntlets on both hands for 20 seconds: haste II and strength, and once a second a shock arcs from you to the nearest foe within 3 blocks for 3 base damage. The pair of the Thunder God's Boots.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.keraunos: Keraunos - the true lightning of the Heart Kingdom training. You are fired as a bolt of lightning up to 20 blocks forward and strike up to 8 foes on the line for 15 base damage each. Needs room to land.
nusmp.page.book_fire.exploding_buckshot: Exploding Buckshot - the throw splits into a spray of small fireballs: a cone of 11 blocks that hits up to 8 foes for 9 base damage and sets them alight. Cast it with the Soul Bat like every Fire page of Magna.
nusmp.page.book_fire.grand_slam: Grand Slam - the bat of swirling flames sends out three fireballs in a fan. Each flies up to 28 blocks and bursts on the first foe it meets, 8 base damage in 2.6 blocks and burning. Cast it with the Soul Bat.
nusmp.page.book_fire.soul_chain_deathmat: Soul Chain Tag Deathmatch - Magna's hidden spell. A fireball hits one foe within 16 blocks (10 base damage, burning) and a chain made of two souls binds you together for 8 seconds: the foe is pulled back when it strays beyond 7 blocks, it hits weaker (weakness II) and you hit harder (strength II). The power split of the series is not modelled.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.double_reflect_re: Double Reflect Refrain - after a Real Double, twice the mirrors of the Reflect Refrain. The light bounces down a lane of 18 blocks twice and cuts up to 8 foes between the mirrors for 16 base damage in all.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_brigade: Mirrors Brigade - a wall of large square mirrors stands round you for 8 seconds. Up to 6 hostile projectiles at a time that come within 5 blocks are turned back on their casters.
nusmp.page.book_poison.verbotenes_obst: Verbotenes Obst - a big mass of liquid poison made between the hands and thrown. It flies up to 27 blocks, bursts where it lands and poisons up to 8 foes within 3.6 blocks for 14 base damage and poison II.
nusmp.page.book_poison.poison_clouds_abo: Poison Cloud's Abode - a cloud of poison spreads where you look and lingers for 8 seconds, 6 blocks in radius. Up to 8 foes inside take 3 base damage and poison every second.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_snare_trap: Ash Snare Trap - a quick trap of ash drawn where you look. For 8 seconds it waits; the first foes that step in take 6 base damage and are held for 4 seconds (weak and almost unable to move).
nusmp.page.book_ash.counter_trap_magic: Counter Trap Magic - Zora's best trap. For 10 seconds a circle under your feet swallows up to 3 hostile spells that enter it; each one comes back at the nearest foe within 18 blocks as 14 base damage (the series returns a trapped spell with twice its power).
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.transforma: Transformation: Borrowed Form - Grey takes another shape. For 15 seconds you are invisible and quick, and mobs within 16 blocks that were hunting you lose you. The mod cannot change a skin, so the disguise is a vanishing act.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.mana_rocke: Mana Rocket Punch - the fist of the hideout tears off and flies on mana: a heavy piercing bolt of 24 blocks that hits everything on its way for 14 base damage and throws it aside.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.mini_bull: The Mini Bull - a small bull cut from the hideout charges 12 blocks ahead, tramples up to 8 foes for 10 base damage and throws them forward.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.fallen_angel_win: Fallen Angel Wingbeat - a sphere of space hits one foe within 18 blocks (6 base damage) and throws it to another place 12 to 20 blocks away. It needs somewhere solid to land the foe.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.dark_hunting_grou: Dark Hunting Ground - the Canis state's spell. A great shadow wraps everyone within 8 blocks for 6 seconds: 5 base damage a second to up to 8 foes, blindness and slowness.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.atonement_monumen: Atonement Monument - the foes within 6 blocks (up to 4) are drawn down into the shadows and buried in an empty world: 22 base damage, held for 4 seconds in darkness. You are not harmed.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.inverse_release: Inverse Release - the open hand forces what is shut to open. You and up to 8 allies within 8 blocks are freed of slowness, weakness, blindness, darkness, mining fatigue, levitation and nausea, and of a sealed grimoire.
